verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a backend-as-a-service platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no way to run the core product on your own infrastructure. The docs describe a fully managed service ('without managing servers', deploying 'to our servers'), and community users point to lock-in. The Local Emulator Suite runs locally but is documented only for testing and QA 'without touching production data', which is an adjacent feature rather than self-hosting.
